import bpy, json, math
scene=bpy.data.scenes['TLT_Melee_Authoring'];bpy.context.window.scene=scene
DATA=json.loads(scene['authoring_input']);fps=scene.render.fps
MAPPING={'right':'RightShoulder','left':'LeftShoulder','elbow':'RightElbow','leftElbow':'LeftElbow','wrist':'RightWrist','neck':'Neck','torso':'Waist','rightHip':'RightHip','leftHip':'LeftHip','rightKnee':'RightKnee','leftKnee':'LeftKnee','weapon':'WeaponSocket'}
# Author the chamber and engaged finish in Blender; keep the accepted contact
# poses and server strike durations as the alignment reference.
g=DATA['guard']['knight'];g.update(right=[36,7,-10],elbow=[25,0,0],weapon=[-92,0,0],torso=[2,0,-1])
g=DATA['guard']['dwarf'];g.update(right=[42,3,-16],elbow=[28,0,0],weapon=[-94,0,0],left=[34,8,20],leftElbow=[34,0,0],torso=[3,2,-3])
c=DATA['clips'][0];c['load'].update(right=[82,-22,-18],elbow=[38,0,0],torso=[5,-22,-4])
c=DATA['clips'][1];c['load'].update(right=[60,55,20],elbow=[34,0,0],torso=[3,22,4]);c['follow']['torso']=[-5,-23,-5]
c=DATA['clips'][2];c['load'].update(right=[122,-12,-14],elbow=[42,0,0],torso=[8,-17,-5])
c=DATA['clips'][3];c['load'].update(right=[118,6,-28],elbow=[46,0,0],torso=[12,14,-7],left=[48,15,26],leftElbow=[36,0,0]);c['follow']['leftElbow']=[30,0,0]
for c in DATA['clips']:
 for p in [c['load'],c['hit'],c['follow'],DATA['guard'][c['classId']]]:
  t=p['torso'];p['neck']=[-t[0]*.25,-t[1]*.5,-t[2]*.35]
def curves(action,rig):
 return action.layers[0].strips[0].channelbag(rig.animation_data.action_slot).fcurves
for old in list(bpy.data.actions):
 if old.get('motion_source')=='Blender MCP native armature F-curves':bpy.data.actions.remove(old)
created=[]
for clip in DATA['clips']:
 rig=bpy.data.objects[clip['classId']+'_Rig'];rig.animation_data_create();action=bpy.data.actions.new(clip['name']);rig.animation_data.action=action
 w,a,r=clip['windup'],clip['active'],clip['recovery'];hit=w+clip['hitDelay'];duration=clip['duration']
 action['classId']=clip['classId'];action['combo']=clip['combo'];action['duration']=duration;action['contact']=hit;action['motion_source']='Blender MCP native armature F-curves'
 for channel in DATA['channels']:
  # Torso/hips lead the arm; elbow and weapon settle after it.
  lead=.35 if channel in ['torso','rightHip','leftHip','rightKnee','leftKnee'] else .50 if channel in ['elbow','leftElbow','wrist'] else .52 if channel=='weapon' else .45
  followFactor=.03 if channel=='torso' else .25 if channel=='weapon' else .22 if channel in ['elbow','wrist'] else .18
  times=[0,w*lead,hit,w+a+r*followFactor,duration]
  vals=[DATA['rest'][clip['classId']][channel],clip['load'][channel],clip['hit'][channel],clip['follow'][channel],DATA['guard'][clip['classId']][channel]]
  pb=rig.pose.bones[MAPPING[channel]]
  for nativeAxis,(blenderAxis,sign) in enumerate([(0,1),(2,1),(1,-1)]):
   ys=[math.radians(p[nativeAxis])*sign for p in vals]
   for t,y in zip(times,ys):
    pb.rotation_euler[blenderAxis]=y;pb.keyframe_insert(data_path='rotation_euler',index=blenderAxis,frame=t*fps,group=channel)
   path=pb.path_from_id('rotation_euler');fc=next(f for f in curves(action,rig) if f.data_path==path and f.array_index==blenderAxis)
   slopes=[0.0]*5
   for i in range(1,4):
    h0,h1=times[i]-times[i-1],times[i+1]-times[i];d0,d1=(ys[i]-ys[i-1])/h0,(ys[i+1]-ys[i])/h1
    if d0*d1>0:
     a0,a1=2*h1+h0,h1+2*h0;slopes[i]=(a0+a1)/(a0/d0+a1/d1)
   for i,k in enumerate(fc.keyframe_points):
    k.interpolation='BEZIER';k.handle_left_type='FREE';k.handle_right_type='FREE'
    left=(times[i]-times[i-1])/3 if i else times[1]/3;right=(times[i+1]-times[i])/3 if i<4 else (times[4]-times[3])/3
    k.handle_left=(k.co.x-left*fps,ys[i]-slopes[i]*left);k.handle_right=(k.co.x+right*fps,ys[i]+slopes[i]*right)
   fc.update()
 created.append({'name':action.name,'fcurves':len(curves(action,rig)),'contact_frame':hit*fps,'duration_frames':duration*fps})
for cls,name in [('knight','Knight_Forehand'),('dwarf','Dwarf_HeavyCut')]:bpy.data.objects[cls+'_Rig'].animation_data.action=bpy.data.actions[name]
scene['authored_clips']=json.dumps(DATA)
scene.frame_set(13)
print(json.dumps({'actions':created,'frame':scene.frame_current,'keyframe_policy':'shared Bezier tangents at contact; body leads arm, weapon settles last'}))
